# SVG Stack icon artwork

Source: [Apple IOS Icon Set](https://svgstack.com/collections/apple-ios-icon-set).
Publisher / credited contributor: [SVG Stack](https://svgstack.com).
Retrieved: 2026-10-17.

SVG Stack's [License Policy](https://svgstack.com/page/license) specifies
Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). The policy and the
individual source pages were checked before importing. The complete license is
in `third_party/licenses/CC-BY-4.0.txt` and the APK's license assets.

`assets.json` records every individual source page, the publisher's original
full-size WebP image URL, the bundled file and its SHA-256. These 22 WebP images
are bundled without modification or runtime downloads. No SVG export is claimed.
Android scales and masks the images; Dark, Tinted and Clear are Vitreo treatments
of this artwork. Clock hands/numerals and Calendar text are drawn dynamically to
show the current local time/date. These adaptations are identified in the APK's
Open source licenses screen as well.

The launcher APK's own Vitreo icon remains the original round adaptive mark.
Apple and other product names/logos identify their respective apps; no affiliation
or endorsement is claimed.

Since 0.5.0 Contacts uses original MIT-licensed vector address-book artwork in
`app/src/main/res/drawable/ios_contacts.xml`; the former blue SVG Stack image was removed.
